REST.$description: Root surface for the page, app background or canvas. Content and containers sit on it. A container placed on it takes background-surface-tone-1; a container that should match the page takes no surface. Keywords: page, canvas, root

Root surface for UI that renders over the page rather than in it: modals, drawers, menus, tooltips. Not for panels that are part of the layout. A container inside it takes background-surface-tone-1. Keywords: layer, dialog, popover, drawer, floating, dropdown, elevated

Surface tone for containers that group, separate or emphasize. Use it for a container that sits directly on the page, on a floating surface, or on background-surface-tone-2. The two tones alternate, so a container never repeats the surface behind it. Keywords: container, card, panel

Surface tone for containers that group, separate or emphasize. Use it for a container that sits on background-surface-tone-1. Not for use directly on the page or on a floating surface. Keywords: container, card, panel, nested
